mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals economic deterioration that triggers equity selling pressure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative SPX returns in at least 60% of cases over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profit growth prospects, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid year-over-year CPI acceleration above 5.0% signals persistent inflation that forces aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 152,000 thousand indicate robust labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 152,000.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1,600 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (2017=100) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.
